title: Inverse image of the torsor extension
statement: Let $u:Y\to X$ be a morphism of schemes and let $G$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{Et}}$. For a $G$-torsor $T$, let $0\to G\to E_T\to\mathbf Z_X\to0$ be the canonical extension used in [lem-sc-torsor-h1], whose fibre over $1$ is $T$. Then inverse image along $u$ carries this short exact sequence to $0\to u^{-1}G\to u^{-1}E_T\to\mathbf Z_Y\to0$, and the resulting extension is canonically the extension $E_{u^{-1}T}$ attached to the inverse-image torsor; its fibre over $1$ is $u^{-1}T$.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 03AJ (label lemma-torsors-h1), functoriality of the extension E_T: u^{-1}E_T = E_{u^{-1}T}
